title: Coordinate unified release train for API + Console + Runtime
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: run a coordinated release train that delivers the API feature set (streaming improvements + structured output), the Console observability dashboard updates, and runtime kernel/batching improvements in a single, aligned cut for April. This ticket owns the milestones, scope-lock criteria, cut decision, release notes coordination, and cross-team GTM checklist for API/Console/Runtime. We will minimize customer-facing risk by defining hard cut criteria and fallbacks, and by sequencing releases so that runtime/infra changes are backward-compatible with the API surface. Tradeoffs: delaying small Console UX polish to avoid cascading test matrix for runtime optimizations; accepting a minimal set of structured-output SDK changes to hit SLA for enterprise customers.
milestones: 2026-03-21: Feature complete for API and Console (no new features after this date)
2026-03-28: Integration testing start (API <-> Runtime compatibility matrix validated)
2026-04-01: Scope lock (freeze non-critical UI polish and docs content)
2026-04-06: Cut decision meeting and final canary plan agreed
2026-04-08: Release notes drafted and legal/compliance sign-off
rollout_cut_criteria: All P0 regressions fixed and verified on staging
API contract compatibility tests pass (100% coverage for top 10 endpoints)
Runtime performance: median token latency within 10% of target and 95th percentile within SLO
Console dashboards show no critical telemetry gaps for rollout canaries
Release notes and migration docs published and linked
Enterprise customers with Dedicated/Private deployments notified and opt-in windows scheduled
acceptance_criteria: Smoke tests green for API, Console, and Runtime on staging
Canary policy configured (1% traffic) with automatic rollback on error-rate spike >3x baseline
SDKs updated with structured-output examples and integration tests
E2E demo recorded for Sales and Support referencing new observability panels
go_to_market_tasks: Prepare release notes: feature summary, breaking changes, migration steps (owner: PM docs)
Coordinate customer communications: email templates for enterprise and changelog for self-serve users (owner: Growth)
Sales enablement: ship playbook + recorded demo + FAQ (owner: Solutions)
Support runway: update runbooks and incident playbooks with runtime fallback steps (owner: SRE)
Marketing: blog draft and launch timeline (owner: Growth Marketing)
Marketplace listings updated with new runtime/feature tags (owner: Partnerships)
updates: 2026-02-25: Ticket created to centralize release planning across API/Console/Runtime — initial scoping done in weekly PM sync.
2026-03-03: Engineering provided rough compatibility matrix; two runtime kernel changes flagged as high risk (ENG-3942). Decided to add canary rollback and extended integration test coverage.
2026-03-10: UX team deferred non-critical Console animation polish to post-release to reduce QA surface — accepted by product and design.
2026-03-14: Draft release notes skeleton created and assigned to technical writer; legal asked to review data-retention blurb by 2026-03-22.
Next steps: finalize scope lock checklist by 2026-03-28, schedule cut decision meeting for 2026-04-06.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Runtime kernel change causes 95th percentile latency regression. Mitigation: keep previous kernel variant in routing policy and enable instant fallback for canary traffic.
Risk: Docs not ready by cut. Mitigation: lock scope early and assign writer with clear SLAs; publish minimal migration steps first.
Risk: Enterprise customers need extra validation for Private deployment. Mitigation: schedule opt-in pilot window and run a pre-cut validation checklist with Customer Success.
